description: Calculate how much output you would receive when swapping one asset for another. Use this tool to answer questions like 'how much ETH would I get for 100 RUNE?' Returns expected output amount, fees, slippage, estimated time, and a memo for executing the swap.

affiliate_bps.description: The affiliate fee in basis points (0-1000; protocol caps total affiliate fees at 1000 bps)

amount.description: The amount in base units (1e8 for most assets)

destination.description: The destination address for the swap output

name: quote_swap
